notes: 5 photos, all overhead digital/printed menu boards for the same restaurant, largely legible. Two boards show overlapping proteins at different price tiers under different section names (A la Carte vs Combos vs Plates vs Combo Plates) so all are kept as their own sections rather than merged/deduped against each other. Dropped sections too blurry, cut off at photo edge, or partial to transcribe reliably: 'Sides', 'VIP' bulk combos, a party-tray fragment showing only '$149.99', 'Sauces' (names only, no prices), and salad-dressing add-ons.
